_comment: Was a SET_FLAG that nothing reads, so the card did nothing at all. 'Prevent the next N damage' is a one-shot replacement (CR 6.4). The prevention is ARCANE-specific, which PREVENT_DAMAGE now honours; untyped it would also have blocked physical damage. The self-destroy is at the beginning of the ACTION PHASE (CR 4.3.1), not the start of the turn.
